_help: One table row per paper and language. Copy this object (without _help) to the end of work/records.json and fill it from the documentation sheet. Values in <...> are explanations.
Language: <language of the rated words, e.g., German; one row per language>
Authors: <label = 'First author et al. (Year)' / 'A and B (Year)'; year = official publication year; add a/b if the same label exists>
Publication type: <e.g., Journal article (Behavior Research Methods, 52(3), 1-20); Preprint (PsyArXiv); PhD thesis (University)>
Sensorimotor variables: <what was rated, e.g., Six perceptual modalities (...) and five action effectors (...)>
Data level: <e.g., Item means and SDs; trial-level data on OSF>
Paper link: <https://doi.org/... (a DOI is used for the reference list)>

_v3.Study type: <norming study | stimulus ratings in experimental study | thesis | model-generated | database>
_v3.Rater group: <general adults | L2 bilinguals | older adults | children | n/a (for LLM) | other group name; several separated by '; '>
_v3.Perspective: <own | typical person | child | possible vs. actual | not specified; empty if the exact wording is not available>
_v3.POS group: <Nouns | Verbs | Adjectives | Mixed | Other | Not reported>
